title: Units sold per product per month, 2025
prompt: Inventory planning wants units sold per product per month for 2025. Order_items start at one row per line item — what does a row need to represent once you've built what inventory asked for?
population: Order_items on completed orders placed in 2025.
grain: Starts at one row per order item; ends at one row per product per month.
metricDefinition: sum(quantity) per product per month, for completed orders in 2025.
referenceSql: SELECT oi.product_id, date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, sum(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY oi.product_id, date_trunc('month', o.order_date)
